- Display Name: Bob Smith
- Current Job Title: Senior Developer

1. Made Bob Smith the new team owner of the TechCorp Solutions Team
2. Updated Alice Johnson's role from owner to member

These changes ensure that:
- Bob now has full administrative access as the project lead
- Alice maintains appropriate visibility and collaboration capabilities as a member
- Team permissions now accurately reflect the updated project structure
- The team's governance aligns with your current organizational needs

The ownership transition is now complete, and the TechCorp Solutions Team permissions have been updated to match the new responsibilities. Bob can now manage team settings, channels, and membership while Alice can continue contributing as an individual contributor with appropriate access levels.
